pass.answer: No. Every run starts from a throwaway home with no CLAUDE.md, rules, settings or memory, so your rules never load, and a shim that re-injects them measures the shim. Use /harness-config:unhobble instead: strip the instructions on a branch, log where the model stumbles, and restore only what repeated evidence earns.
Plugin eval can't measure that: each run uses a clean, isolated home where CLAUDE.md isn't loaded. The route is `/harness-config:unhobble`.
